title: iniBuilds New Orleans, Mexico City & 900+ KL Landmarks! | MSFS 2024 Marketplace
description:
Looking to expand your global route network in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 this week, or deciding which new airports and city packs are actually worth your money? Today's Marketplace update rolls out a massive globe-spanning wave of 11 scenery releases—from flagship commercial hubs like iniBuilds New Orleans (KMSY) and FlyMex Mexico City (MMMX) to wintery Swedish Lapland, historic British airfields, and a 900-building Kuala Lumpur skyline! Plus, existing MSFS 2020 owners of Port Harcourt International (DNPO) can claim a free cross-buy upgrade for MSFS 2024.

In this scenery breakdown, we inspect terminal interiors, apron textures, night lighting, and realistic expectations across every new MSFS 2024 Marketplace release:

🛫 NORTH AMERICAN COMMERCIAL & COASTAL GATEWAYS
We kick things off with three major gateways across the Gulf Coast and Mexico:
• iniBuilds Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (KMSY): Handcrafted MSFS 2024 rendition near Lake Pontchartrain featuring detailed terminal interiors, Signature Aviation FBO facilities, and dense apron clutter.
• FlyMex Mexico City International Airport (MMMX): Latin America's busiest hub brought to MSFS 2024 with updated Terminals 1 and 2, aprons, taxiways, and monorail infrastructure.
• FlyMex Puerto Escondido International Airport (MMPS): Ported Mexican Pacific coastal airport serving the world-famous surf destination with updated runways, taxiways, and terminal buildings.

🏰 EUROPEAN REGIONAL GATEWAYS & GRASSROOTS AIRFIELDS
Heading across the Atlantic for Italian city approaches, Lapland snow, and WWII British aviation history:
• Salvuz Naples Capodichino Airport (LIRN): Compact commercial hub just kilometers from central Naples with modeled terminal/hangar interiors and custom night lighting.
• Salvuz Pisa International Airport (LIRP): Main gateway to Tuscany near the Leaning Tower, rebuilt for MSFS 2024 with 2025 airport layout data, Pisa Mover monorail, and upgraded night lighting.
• Skellefteå Airport (ESNS): Northern Sweden regional airfield featuring full winter seasonality, snow cover, and modeled control tower interiors.
• Burning Blue Design Turweston Aerodrome (EGBT): Historic Buckinghamshire airfield with 100+ custom 3D objects, animated spectators and vehicles, working fuel truck, and detailed tower cafe and control room interiors.

🌍 WEST AFRICAN INTERNATIONAL HUBS
• MSFS Rebuilds Port Harcourt International Airport (DNPO): Located in Rivers State, Nigeria with both international and domestic terminals—available as a FREE cross-buy upgrade if you already own the MSFS 2020 edition.

🏙️ HANDCRAFTED METROPOLITAN SKYLINES
Upgrade your VFR sightseeing and night approaches across three major cities:
• CloudSurf Asia Simulations Mega Kuala Lumpur: Available to rent or buy, packing over 900 custom 3D buildings across Greater Kuala Lumpur including the Petronas Twin Towers, Merdeka 118, and harbor landmarks.
• FlyMex Mexico City Landmarks: Custom downtown skyscrapers and points of interest to pair with MMMX arrivals.
• Iron Sim Memphis City Landmarks: Handcrafted Memphis skyline featuring custom night lighting on the Memphis Pyramid and Hernando de Soto Bridge.

Which of these new sceneries are you loading into first? Flying narrowbody routes into iniBuilds New Orleans, exploring Mega Kuala Lumpur, or claiming your free Port Harcourt upgrade? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2024 scenery releases, don't forget to hit like, subscribe to the channel for weekly simulator coverage, and clear skies on your next departure!
